name: es20-copy-and-read-pixels
title: Copy and read pixels: glReadPixels, glCopyTexImage2D, glCopyTexSubImage2D
summary: glReadPixels with the required RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE pair and the implementation-chosen pair (decoded for eight renderbuffer formats), sub-rectangles, PACK_ALIGNMENT / PACK_ROW_LENGTH / PACK_SKIP_* layouts, reads over the framebuffer edge; glCopyTexImage2D into eight internal formats and glCopyTexSubImage2D patches checked texel by texel; the defined error cases of both command families.
spec: ES 3.0 §3.7.1 Pixel Storage Modes (Tables 3.1, 4.4), §3.7.2 Transfer of Pixel Rectangles (§3.7.2.1 unpacking and packing, equation 3.13; §3.7.2.2 special interpretations, Table 3.6)
ES 3.0 §3.8.5 Alternate Texture Image Specification Commands (glCopyTexImage2D, glCopyTexSubImage2D, Tables 3.15 to 3.17), §3.8.5.1 Texture Copying Feedback Loops
ES 3.0 §3.8.3 Texture Image Specification (Tables 3.3, 3.11 and 3.13), §3.9.2 / Table 3.24 (what a shader sees for LUMINANCE, ALPHA and LUMINANCE_ALPHA)
ES 3.0 §4.3.1 Selecting a Buffer for Reading, §4.3.2 Reading Pixels (§4.3.2.1 obtaining pixels, §4.3.2.3 final conversion, Table 4.5), §4.3.3 Copying Pixels
ES 3.0 §4.4.4.4 Effects of Framebuffer Completeness on Framebuffer Operations, §4.4.5 Effects of Framebuffer State on Framebuffer Dependent Values
ES 3.0 §2.1.6.2 Conversion from Floating-Point to Normalized Fixed-Point (equation 2.3)
GLSL ES 3.00 §4.5.4 Default Precision Qualifiers, §7.1 gl_VertexID, §7.2 gl_FragCoord, §8.8 Texture Lookup Functions

api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE of a 64x64 chart equals the analytic image (+-1); six sub-rectangles equal the same block of the full read exactly; PACK_ALIGNMENT 1/2/4/8, PACK_ROW_LENGTH, PACK_SKIP_PIXELS/ROWS place every pixel where equation 3.13 says; the implementation-chosen pair of the default framebuffer, an RGBA8 chart and eight renderbuffer formats decodes to the expected values; reads over the edge: in-window pixels correct; INVALID_OPERATION for RGB/4444, RGBA/565, RGBA_INTEGER/UNSIGNED_INT on a fixed-point buffer, READ_BUFFER NONE and an empty read attachment
api.glPixelStorei: PACK_ALIGNMENT 1/2/4/8, PACK_ROW_LENGTH, PACK_SKIP_PIXELS, PACK_SKIP_ROWS change the memory layout exactly as modelled; PACK_ALIGNMENT 3 and PACK_ROW_LENGTH -1 -> INVALID_VALUE, state unchanged
api.glGetIntegerv: PACK_ALIGNMENT (initial 4, then each set value), PACK_ROW_LENGTH/SKIP_PIXELS/SKIP_ROWS, IMPLEMENTATION_COLOR_READ_FORMAT and _TYPE (used to read; INVALID_OPERATION with READ_BUFFER NONE)
api.glReadBuffer: NONE makes glReadPixels, glCopyTexImage2D and glCopyTexSubImage2D fail with INVALID_OPERATION; COLOR_ATTACHMENT1 (no image attached) makes glReadPixels fail; COLOR_ATTACHMENT0 restores reading
api.glCopyTexImage2D: RGBA, RGBA8, RGB, LUMINANCE, ALPHA, LUMINANCE_ALPHA, R8, RG8 from a whole chart and a 32x24 sub-rectangle: every texel equals the expected component mapping (exact through an attached framebuffer, +-1 when sampled); copies come from the READ framebuffer; RGB8 source -> RGBA/ALPHA/LUMINANCE_ALPHA and RGBA8 source -> RGB565/RGBA4 -> INVALID_OPERATION; border 1, a non-square cube face -> INVALID_VALUE; READ_BUFFER NONE -> INVALID_OPERATION
api.glCopyTexSubImage2D: two patches (16x16 and 24x24) replace exactly their rectangles of a 64x64 texture, every other texel keeps its value; rectangle outside the level or negative offset -> INVALID_VALUE; READ_BUFFER NONE -> INVALID_OPERATION
api.glTexImage2D: allocates the base texture of the glCopyTexSubImage2D scene from CPU data (texels observed after the patches)
api.glGenTextures: eight copy targets, one patched texture, scratch texture
api.glTexParameteri: MIN/MAG_FILTER NEAREST: copied textures (level 0 only) are complete and sampled texel by texel
api.glActiveTexture: unit 0 carries the texture sampled by the show program
api.glGenFramebuffers: chart, scratch, attach and per-format framebuffers
api.glBindFramebuffer: READ_FRAMEBUFFER = chart while DRAW_FRAMEBUFFER = default (the copies and reads use READ); FRAMEBUFFER for rendering
api.glFramebufferRenderbuffer: RGBA8, RGB8, RGB565, RGBA4, RGB5_A1, RGB10_A2, RG8, R8 renderbuffers as COLOR_ATTACHMENT0 of read framebuffers
api.glFramebufferTexture2D: copied textures attached to a framebuffer to read their texels back exactly
api.glCheckFramebufferStatus: COMPLETE for every renderbuffer format above and for each renderable copied texture
api.glBindRenderbuffer: target for storage and parameter queries
api.glRenderbufferStorage: eight color formats; component sizes read back to model the expected values
api.glGetRenderbufferParameteriv: RED/GREEN/BLUE/ALPHA_SIZE of the actual storage select which components are expected to read back as 0,0,0,1
api.glBlitFramebuffer: 1:1 NEAREST copy of the chart to the default framebuffer: the cell equals the chart exactly
api.glClearColor: cleared color of each renderbuffer format is what the implementation-pair read decodes to
api.glClear: COLOR_BUFFER_BIT of the format-test and scratch framebuffers
api.glGetUniformLocation: u_rect, u_tex, u_mode located; observed in the pixels
api.glUniform1i: sampler unit and u_mode (RGB, alpha-as-gray, raw RGBA) select what the sampled copies show
api.glUniform4f: u_rect places the chart quad and the texture quads
api.glDrawArrays: TRIANGLE_STRIP, 4 vertices from gl_VertexID: chart and sampled textures

visual_review.notes: 256x256 radeonsi es-max capture viewed (all six matrix captures are byte-identical). Row 1: the test chart (red grows to the right, green upward, blue 8x8 checkerboard; it was blitted with its alpha 128..254 so a viewer shows it paler than the next cell); the full RGBA copy (identical, opaque); a uniform blue-gray texture with a small 16x16 patch lower left and a 24x24 patch upper right (two glCopyTexSubImage2D); the 32x24 RGBA8 sub-rectangle at 2x. Row 2: RGB sub-rectangle; LUMINANCE (gray ramp from the red channel); ALPHA shown as light gray (alpha 128+x+y); LUMINANCE_ALPHA (red ramp as gray). Row 3: R8 (black to red ramp) and RG8 (red and green ramps). The bottom row is empty by design.
